sentences.en: The slickly produced pamphlet listed numerous general goals but offered little in the way of specifics and has been roundly criticized.

sentences.en: All components of the utility model are glued slickly, so the utility model has the advantages of simple structure and convenient operation(sentencedict.com), and can ensure the production quality.

sentences.en: This slickly styled subcompact has been a top seller in Europe since late 2008.
